focus.$description: Base focus-ring geometry. Split out from the cognitive-accessibility overrides so a mode that needs a thicker ring redefines one token instead of restyling every focusable component. The ring COLOR stays semantic (semantic.border.focus).

width.$description: Default focus-ring width. [data-a11y-cognitive="true"] promotes this to cognitive.focusRingWidth (3px).

offset.$description: Gap between the control edge and the ring, so the ring stays legible on filled controls.
